summary: `which` index rows exist for every manifest novel feature, including the hand-authored `task attach` and `task attachments`.
reason: whichIndex is rendered from novel_features only at generation time, so novel commands added after the print were listed in --help and agent-context but `which attach` / `which upload` returned no match.
validated_outcome: TestWhichIndexCoversManifestNovelFeatures and TestWhichResolvesAttachmentQueries fail without the rows and pass with them; `which attach`/`which upload` return task attach, `which attachments` returns task attachments.
